title: Thread-Safe Prompt Template Registry with Selective Deep Copy
instructions: In `protoreg.py`, give `PromptTemplate` a selective `__deepcopy__` (clone the examples and parent through the shared memo, share the `HttpClient`, handle cycles), build a thread-safe `TemplateRegistry` that stores private copies and returns a fresh clone on every `get`, and make `Provider` subclasses register themselves through `__init_subclass__`.

evidence.label: A clone has independent mutable data but shares the client
A plain deepcopy of the lock-owning client fails (why sharing is needed)
Cyclic parent references are cloned correctly through the memo
Objects shared inside one copy stay shared in the clone
get() returns a fresh clone on every call
Unknown names raise KeyError listing known names; names() is sorted
Registering a duplicate name raises KeyError
Eight threads registering one name: exactly one succeeds
Provider subclasses self-register; duplicates and unknown names fail
